More and more people are incorporating mindfulness into their daily lives to improve their well-being, reduce stress, and develop greater self-awareness.

At Nachhilfeunterricht.de, we are looking for Mindfulness Instructors to provide private sessions and support students of all experience levels on their mindfulness journey.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver personalised mindfulness sessions tailored to each student's needs and goals.

  • Teach mindfulness techniques, breathing exercises, relaxation methods, and meditation practices.

  • Design customised exercises to promote well-being, focus, and emotional balance.

  • Monitor students' progress and adapt sessions to support their development.

Requirements

  • Training or experience in Mindfulness, Meditation, or a related discipline.

  • No previous teaching experience required.

  • Excellent communication and coaching skills.

  • Passion for helping others improve their well-being and personal growth.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Teach online, in person, or in a hybrid format.

  • Earn €20–40 per hour.

  • Choose your own schedule and decide how many students you would like to support.

Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is a pioneer in its approach to mental health treatment. In addition to providing superior Clinical care from the nation’s most talented and passionate clinicians, Charlie Health offers unparallelled and effective holistic treatment via our groundbreaking Integrative care including Contemplative, Creative Arts, and Experiential Programming. We firmly believe that thriving, sustainable health is the result of treating the whole person - mind, body, and spirit - and our vIOP deeply embodies this philosophy. As such, we advocate for and provide inclusive, accessible, diverse, cosmopolitan healing approaches that transcend the conventional Western psychological model. Charlie Health’s synergistic Clinical + Integrative treatment model affords cutting edge mental health care that proudly serves our amazing clients.

Charlie Health is excited to expand its Contemplative Programming Department. Aligned with the growing bodies of research that evidence positive psychological transformation as a result of contemplative interventions and practices rooted in wisdom traditions, our Contemplative Practitioners support our clients in developing mindful awareness, cultivating wisdom, discovering purpose, living compassionately, and practicing self-inquiry. Some of our current therapeutic modalities include Yoga Therapy, Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction, Mindful Self Compassion, Breathwork, Philosophical Consultation, Transpersonal Psychology, Spiritual Coaching, Meditation, and Chaplaincy. Some of the modalities we are eager to include are Contemplative Psychotherapy, Contemplative Arts, Dreamwork, Depth Psychology and many more.

Charlie Health is hiring a few exceptional Contemplative Practitioners to provide remote, telehealth services to our clients. We’re eager to work with forward-thinking mental health and substance use professionals to enhance our programming and provide the best possible care to our clients.

This is a contract / 1099 position that allows you the flexibility to schedule sessions and work wherever you are most comfortable. We request that our facilitators are able to dedicate at minimum 9 permanent group hours per week to facilitate group sessions and build valuable connections with our clients.

People know Charlie Health for our warm and empathetic team. While each individual facilitator has their own interests, expertise, and style, we require all team members to be well versed in a variety of therapeutic modalities. Our clients are struggling to cope with underlying mental health issues and benefit from facilitators that are sophisticated and relational. Successful candidates are committed to bettering the mental health of their clients, and are adept at self-care, ensuring they are prepared to give their best every day to address the rural mental health crisis.

About You

  • Able to demonstrate expertise in your contemplative practices (e.g. Yoga Therapists (C-IAYT), Yoga Teachers (RYT), Mindfulness (MBSR), Mindful Self-Compassion (MSC), etc.) and feel confident integrating them into your treatment approach
  • Confident and experienced in working with a wide range of ages, including children, teens, young adults, and adults
  • Passionate about the benefits of group practices and skilled in conducting group sessions
  • Ability to work effectively in a team
  • Creative and engaging, especially over video!

Qualifications

  • Clinical experience and/or experience in mental health or behavioral health is required for this role. Please do not apply if you do not meet this qualification.
  • Must be available during late afternoons and evenings on weekdays (3-8pm MT on Monday to Thursday) and on Saturdays to meet the schedules of our clients
  • Experience with a wide range of ages, including children, teens, young adults, and adults is required
  • Experience with high acuity populations is required
  • Must be certified in your contemplative practice (all disciplines are welcome to apply), and/or hold a Clinical license
  • Minimum 3 years of teaching/facilitating experience in your contemplative field
  • Master’s degree in mental health or related field strongly preferred
  • Availability between 9 and 40 hours per week
  • The technical ability to run effective telehealth sessions
  • Reliable WIFI connection when meeting with clients
  • 1099 Position, part time with opportunity to grow into full time position
  • Familiarity with and willingness to use cloud-based communication software—Gmail, Slack, Zoom, Dropbox–in addition to EMR and survey software on a daily basis
  • Work authorized in the United States and native or bilingual English proficiency

Benefits

  • Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

Based on the nature of this role, you will need to complete several state background checks for clearance to see clients. Florida requires a fingerprint based background check, with more information found here. Please note that the cost for this background check will be paid for in full by Charlie Health.

Our Values

  • Connection: Care deeply & inspire hope.
  • Congruence: Stay curious & heed the evidence.
  • Commitment: Act with urgency & don’t give up.

All communications with Charlie Health Talent and People Operations professionals will only be sent from @charliehealth.com email addresses. Legitimate emails will never originate from gmail.com, yahoo.com, or other commercial email services.

Recruiting agencies, please do not submit unsolicited referrals for this or any open role. We have a roster of agencies with whom we partner, and we will not pay any fee associated with unsolicited referrals.

At Charlie Health, we value being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to cultivate an environment where individuals can be their authentic selves. Being an Equal Opportunity Employer means every member of our team feels as though they are supported and belong. We value diverse perspectives to help us provide essential mental health and substance use disorder treatments to all young people.

Charlie Health applicants are assessed solely on their qualifications for the role, without regard to disability or need for accommodation.
